name: Beat FX Tab
author: b.sr
summary: Keep the Beat FX panel closed and still see it all: effect, beat value, channel and on/off, in one small label.
description:
New in 1.1: colours matched to the deck's stock theme, a channel row (CH SELECT), TIME in a grey box while you turn the TIME knob, and fixes: the label no longer vanishes after a CH SELECT press.

Keep the BEAT FX panel closed and get your screen space back. On the 2 DECK waveform views, the collapsed tab shows the effect, its beat value (REVERB: LENGTH %; X-PAD on the pad) and its channel (3 1 2 4, MST, MIC, A, B). Off: grey; on: lit in the effect's color. Tap it as usual to open the stock panel.

Display only: no hooks, files or network. Known issue: it stays on top of TRACK INFO.
